notes.title: Welcome to the Trial of the Gods - Update 1.0.3
notes.content:
Update 1.0.3

Greetings Trial-Goers!

Welcome to the Trial of the Gods

It was brought to our attention that our last patch made the build unplayable for Oculus users. After a closer a look,  we found the issue and have fixed it. We are sorry for the inconvenience and appreciate everyone's patience with us. 

Patch Notes:

Fixed instant closing of game bug for Oculus users
Fixed textures in Anubis


As always we will be updating the game. Feel free to reach out to us if you have any issue! :)
 
Good luck on your Trial followers.

Thank you for supporting Trial of the Gods.

notes.title: Welcome to the Trial of the Gods - Update 1.0.2
notes.content:
Update 1.0.2

Greetings Trial-Goers!

Welcome to the Trial of the Gods

Thank you everyone for the recent feedback about bugs. We appreciate the 
 continued support on the release of our first game. 

Since our last update we have continued to work hard to ensure that your experience is the best possible.

If there is any feedback, comments, bugs, or questions. Please let us know. We would love to hear from you all!

Patch Notes:

Fixed Teleportation between both hands.
Fixed issue with the hands not showing up.
Fixed the issue with watch falling off.
Added Auto save after tomb has been completes.
Added a  unlimited time mode after completing the game. 
Fixed the issue where teleport indicator doesn't reappear after game over. 
Fixed the rings in the hub to lock with a lower tolerance
Reworked turning for Oculus players
Cleaned visual inconsistency  


We will be updating the game, so be sure to check back soon. 

Good luck on your Trial followers.

Thank you for supporting Trial of the Gods.

notes.title: Update Coming Soon!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!!! We are excited to announce our second update! We will be releasing it tomorrow June 26th!

This update will include:
* Auto Save
* Updating the Teleportation
* Unlimited Time Mode
* Quality of Life Improvements
* And More!

Thank you for your patience and feedback! Happy Gaming!! Big thank you to Showpony for all the great feedback!!!

notes.title: Welcome to the Trial of the Gods - Update 1.0.1
notes.content:
Update 1.0.1

Greetings Trial-Goers!

Welcome to the Trial of the Gods

Thank you for the recent feedback about bugs. We appreciate the support on the release of our first game. 

We have identified a few bugs with our initial release and we have fixed them.

If there is any feedback, comments, bugs, or questions let us know. We would love to hear from you all!

Patch Notes:

Fixed Teleportation boundaries.
Teleportation indicator now properly appears.
Achievements now properly fire and no longer hinder progression.
Added display message when no VR hardware is found.
Fixed Floating Skull Puzzle bug.
Changed location of a Soul spawning.
Chain attachment fixed.


We will be updating the game, so be sure to check back soon. 

Good luck on your Trial followers.

Thank you for supporting Trial of the Gods.
